definitions: A group of physical and emotional symptoms that occur in the one to two weeks before a woman's menstrual period.
A condition characterized by a recurring set of symptoms including irritability, depression, bloating, and breast tenderness, experienced by some women in the days leading up to menstruation.
examples: She experiences severe Premenstrual Syndrome every month.
Many women seek remedies for Premenstrual Syndrome.
Understanding Premenstrual Syndrome can help manage its effects.
